title: Shared decision corpus: prediction vs intervention

s1_policy.rule: treat if true risk score > corpus median risk
s1_policy.note: a purely predictive ranker; it has no representation of an action that is not taken

segments.name: persuadable_high_risk
segments.note: high risk, large positive effect - treat

segments.name: persuadable_low_risk
segments.note: low risk, large positive effect - treat, and a ranker never gets here

segments.name: lost_cause
segments.note: high risk, no effect - a ranker spends its whole budget here

segments.name: sure_thing
segments.note: low risk, no effect - correctly skipped by both

segments.name: sleeping_dog_high_risk
segments.note: high risk, treating HARMS - the case a ranker cannot represent

segments.name: marginal_positive
segments.note: effect positive but near the cost line - the decision-margin case

segments.name: marginal_negative
segments.note: effect positive but BELOW the cost line - do nothing is correct

does_not_serve.SE2: question text is templated; SE2 needs natural phrasing from real tickets and prompts, hand-labelled by two raters
